plain_summary: Both runs read the command-line connection code. Early RL described the known unsafe data-reading bug. Final RL described a related problem with the wrong data direction, and the checker rejected the match.
software_and_risk: A server that runs software builds. A flaw in reading untrusted data could let that data trigger program execution on the server.
submitted_report_summary: Reported three possible issues, with a related data-reading claim.
known_bug_checker_summary: The checker rejected the claim because it described the wrong direction of the incoming data.

terminal_validity.note: Valid completed quality result. A missed target is not a pipeline exception.

cost_scenario.cache_assumption: All input uncached; no verified cache discount.
cost_scenario.boundary: Detector generation tokens only; excludes checker, infrastructure, training and billed provider costs.
cost_scenario.label: Illustrative OpenRouter price scenario, not actual spend.

code_files_read.description: Reads data arriving through a connection

export_notice: Sanitized chronological reconstruction from existing Langfuse events and S3 rollout metadata. Not a verbatim full provider transcript. Actual benign excerpts and safe summaries are labeled separately.
